issue: Duplicate admin news posts were created for flanel and mansester after an unclear create response was retried.
root_cause: The first create attempt likely succeeded, but the response was parsed from the wrong JSON path. A second create attempt then created another flanel and mansester post.

delete_results.message: Successfully deleted news post with ID: 2276
Successfully deleted news post with ID: 2277

guardrail_added: Never retry biznisweb-add_news_post for the same article after a null or malformed response.
Parse create responses only from result.content[0].text and persist the real news_post.id immediately.
If a create response is unclear, stop and inspect admin/API state before any retry.
Direct API creation is allowed only for hidden drafts unless slug/date-safe publication is verified.
